summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.57/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.57 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 14, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ higher than a week ago, 23¢ lower than a month ago, and 65¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.32) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.79).
